notes: 89 base objects (7 Chests, 7 Magic chests, 25 Crafting stations, 30 Base & furniture, 20 Sparkworks); 86 have a 1.0 recipe. Not crafted: Tiny Chest, Spawner, Sparkworks Trigger Zone (confidence 'unknown', with 'obtained' saying how). Source: enshrouded.tools item pages, read from the 1.0 game files (footer: 'Game data: Steam build 25936191'); every recipe is likely-1.0 (datamined, not checked in game). Every station has a craft recipe in 1.0, including the ones the planner notes only as quest rewards; the quests still exist (see quest). Some also have one placed in the world (foundAt, the site's 'Where to find it' line): Smithing Tools, Mortar, Hand Spindle, Loom, Tanning Station, and the parts Crucible, Kettle, Scientific Instruments and Circular Sawblades. station is the station the recipe is made at or needs nearby (for a survivor's recipe, the 'Needs' station, e.g. Masonry Tools; the Oven's 'Almanac of Plants and Seedlings' is a placeable the Farmer makes from Paper x25 and String x5); crafter is the survivor, null for the player. requires is the 'Needs' line of a player station's recipe (none here) and is otherwise empty. Unlike eternal-spells.json it doesn't add 'Sheltered Bed' to survivor recipes: the site's quest The Blacksmith Needs A Shop says only that 'some recipes only craft while their crafter is sheltered', and no item page says which. quest is the quest that introduces the station or hands out its key part (Cauldron, Crucible, Scientific Instruments, Almanac), from the site's quest pages; its Rewards list doesn't say whether you get the item or just its recipe. otherRecipes on chests and magic chests are the site's extra 'By hand' recipes; they aren't labelled, but they match Keen's 1.0 note that 'storage chests can be upgraded or turned into magic chests without emptying them', so they're probably the in-place upgrade costs (inferred). slots come from the planner's pre-1.0 wiki notes: enshrouded.tools doesn't list chest sizes. Placeholders: each planner placeholder maps to up to four real items (placeholder + libraryType); there is no pen or trough item in the game, so 'Animal pen' maps to the animal beds and the cheapest fence and gate, and 'Trough' to the feeders plus the decorative Water Trough. newIn1_0 comes from the site's 1.0 list of new items (Sparkworks Workbench, Lever, Lever With Indicator, Switch Button, Push Button, Pressure Plate, Light, Shootable Button, Goalpost, Lightning Trap, Spike Trap, Trapdoor Wood 2m, Trapdoor Wood 4m, Trapdoor Stone 2m, Trapdoor Stone 4m, Trapdoor Metal 2m, Trapdoor Metal 4m, Sparkworks Switchbox, Sparkworks Tool, Spawner, Sparkworks Trigger Zone). changes1_0 combines the site's 1.0 changelog (a diff of the last Early Access build against 1.0, also kept raw in resources' recipe.changed1_0) with a comparison against the planner's LIBRARY notes (pre-1.0 wiki); a difference the changelog doesn't show is flagged as a stale wiki note. Wood Planks only come from the Table Saw in 1.0, so every plank recipe (Wooden, Medium, Large, Huge Chest, Enormous Magic Chest, Loom, Masonry Tools, Tanning Station...) needs the Table Saw first. Resources follow each input's primary recipe (the one matching the site's 'Where to get it' line; 'Manual Crafting' is the by-hand recipe and 'Huntress' the Hunter); Twigs and Animal Fur are listed as gathered (the site says they drop) with their recipes under otherRecipes. 'Any X' slots are resources of kind gathered with their options; for 'Any Archaic Essence', Archaic Essence I is also listed. The site's prose 'About' blurbs can still quote Early Access numbers; recipe tables are 1.0.
